project_title: Atelier & Galeria d'Arte - Plataforma Editorial de Ensino Artístico

anti_ai_principles: No rounded soft shadows or blurred colored halos - use sharp, crisp 1px solid borders and flat cardless geometry.
No generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮) or standard SaaS blue/purple gradients.
High-contrast stark monochrome palette (Pure Black #000000, Off-White #FAFAFA, Crisp White #FFFFFF, Tinted Muted Slate #171717 and #E5E5E5).
Asymmetric Swiss editorial layout with generous negative space (2-3x default padding) and exposed grid dividers.
Fluid line-mask reveal animations powered by GSAP and Framer Motion for cinematic presence.
Cormorant Garamond italic display serifs paired with ultra-clean Manrope geometric typography.
design_philosophy.reference_style: Kononenko Group (kononenkogroup.com) architectural precision, high editorial contrast, monolithic typography, strict line grids, noise grain overlay.

rules.header_background_rule: Header MUST use semi-solid opaque or glass backdrop with explicit background bg-white/95 or bg-black/95. NEVER fully transparent without background.

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight leading-[0.95]
hierarchy.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.card_h4: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans-editorial font-medium tracking-tight uppercase
hierarchy.label_overline: num-marker text-[11px] tracking-[0.28em] uppercase font-semibold text-neutral-500
hierarchy.body: text-sm sm:text-base font-sans-editorial font-light leading-relaxed text-neutral-800

indexed_videos.title: Pintura Acrílica: Gestos, Impasto e Camadas
indexed_videos.description: Demonstração prática de aplicação de tinta acrílica com espátula e pincel de cerda grossa, explorando a construção de texturas tridimensionais sobre tela.

indexed_videos.title: Técnicas de Pincelada e Textura no Atelier
indexed_videos.description: Estudo minucioso dos ritmos manuais, pigmentação concentrada e secagem por velatura no processo de composição abstrata.

indexed_videos.title: Estudo de Cor, Luz e Composição em Direto
indexed_videos.description: Análise ao vivo da mistura de pigmentos primários e equilíbrio de valores tonais para criar profundidade dramática.

technical_and_testing_rules.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, video triggers, modal closes, inputs, filter chips, nav links) MUST have explicit data-testid in kebab-case format.
technical_and_testing_rules.accessibility: Ensure high contrast black-and-white text readability (WCAG AAA compliant), proper ARIA labels for modal overlays and video players.
technical_and_testing_rules.state_management: Use React state and custom modals for seamless non-disruptive user interactions without full page reloads.
